title: Medicine: MBBS
summary: An English-taught medical degree at accredited universities — with licensing checks for your country.
overview: MBBS in China is a popular route for students looking for an English-taught medical program. Study includes basic sciences, clinical rotations in university hospitals and preparation for licensing exams.

The key question isn't only admission but whether you can practise at home. Recognised university lists and exam requirements differ by country. Before applying we check the specific university and explain the risks instead of promising a degree accepted everywhere.
fitFor: High school graduates with strong chemistry and biology
You need an English-taught medical program
You're ready for 5–6 years of study and clinical practice
Your family wants clarity on budget and recognition
outcomes: Clinical practice in a university hospital
A clear view of the recognition procedure in your country

timeline.text: We check the university's recognition in your jurisdiction and the school subject requirements.

Applications to several universities and the selection process.

faq.question: Is an MBBS from China recognised?
faq.answer: It depends on the country. Some countries recognise Chinese medical degrees under conditions; others require local exams and verification. We check your regulator and the specific university before applying.

faq.question: Can I study in English?
faq.answer: Yes, but there are fewer English-taught medical programs than Chinese-taught ones, and places are limited. Some universities require HSK for patient communication during clinical rotations.
